description.value:
Duration until you move

You stop moving, and the ground behind you becomes somebody else's problem to reach.

While you have not used a move action since the start of your last turn, each ally adjacent to you gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC against Shove, Trip, and Reposition. You lose both the moment you move for any reason, including a forced movement you did not resist.

rules.label: You have not used a move action since the start of your last turn

cinderfall.incomplete: The self half matches this class's own established idiom exactly (toggleable RollOption + predicated FlatModifier). The adjacent-ally +1 circumstance AC bonus is unbuilt: no companion effect exists for this slug, and the closest real precedent (Guardian's Covering Stance) ties its ally-cover grant to an active Stance action, not a bare "haven't moved" toggle.
